snippet.title: Landoria, a real-time strategy RPG (Update #3)
snippet.description:
#indie #indiegame #strategygames #4x #strategy #battle #rpg #dragonforce #segasaturn #dragonforcegame #steam

Landoria is a cartoon fantasy real time strategy and tactics game with mini 4X elements.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2785890/Landoria/

In this update #3, we are showcasing the progress we have made since our last video. The world is revamped with better visuals and support for mini 4X game mechanics. You can now fortify your castles and expand your territories to upgrade various castle stats to aid in your strategy -- better castle stats means faster production and better items. Our quest framework is also starting to mature, which allows us to start building out the story progression in the following weeks.
